# Generation 5 — Infinite Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews every public word, every road, every page in light;
Awtsmoos.com should reveal truthful meaning to human and crawler alike, by day and night.

## Vast possibility field

1. First-class Heichelos landing semantics: title, description, robots, canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter, CollectionPage JSON-LD.
2. Canonical-parity audit between sitemap URL, HTML canonical, and JSON-LD URL/mainEntityOfPage.
3. Cross-family canonical-collision detector.
4. Orphan-page detector for metadata records absent from sitemap and ordinary HTML links.
5. Duplicate-content detector by normalized semantic text/hash across distinct public URLs.
6. Title-quality auditor for duplicates, generic titles, suspicious length, and template leakage.
7. Description-quality auditor for missing, duplicated, tiny, or boilerplate descriptions.
8. Schema-family validator by app/game/profile/post/public-information family.
9. Negative-resource semantic verifier: noindex + no rich schema for missing entities.
10. Alias privacy assertions preventing private fields from entering SSR or JSON-LD.
11. Alias outbound-URL protocol guard and normalization.
12. Alias latency percentile measurement and legacy-fallback query-budget guard.
13. Alias pagination completeness over all real pages.
14. Comment shard no-loss/no-duplicate proof across boundaries.
15. Comment reply/parent canonical relation discovery for possible Comment schema later.
16. Translation malformed-row and empty-language detector.
17. Translation source-link integrity validation.
18. Translation directionality/lang-attribute validation.
19. Translation duplicate-body fingerprint reporting.
20. Translation sitemap/cardinality baselines and regression thresholds.
21. Heichel root → series → stable-post ordinary-link graph verification.
22. Numeric Road → stable canonical semantic-equivalence proof.
23. Direct named-post canonical self-consistency proof.
24. Heichel/post schema author/name/date omission rules for missing source data.
25. Heichel root/series title consistency checks.
26. App/game registry ghost detection.
27. App/game final-slash/file canonical normalization.
28. Static metadata authored-tag preservation tests.
29. Structured JSON escaping tests for Hebrew, apostrophes, ampersands, `<script>`, and Unicode.
30. Sitemap MIME/HTTP/header/size/count validation locally and publicly.
31. Sitemap nesting-depth and crawl-budget diagnostics.
32. Runtime crawler latency percentiles and slowest-page ledger.
33. Runtime crawler resumable checkpoint snapshots.
34. Transport-retry telemetry separated from HTTP failures.
35. Full-graph deep crawl across every discovered URL.
36. Visible-H1 advisory ranking by user value instead of hidden SEO text.
37. Integration transplant manifest rejecting unexpected files.
38. Byte-for-byte SHA comparison between tested dirty source and clean-worktree transplant.
39. Generated-artifact provenance/idempotence ledger.
40. Exact current-origin race gate immediately before commit and push.
41. Release manifest coverage verifier with native regeneration only on evidence.
42. Exact pushed SHA verification on remote main.
43. Exact-SHA production activation and service evidence.
44. Raw-public acceptance across every family.
45. Browser-shadow verification for one app/game/profile/Torah page.
46. Production canonical/schema parity checks after activation.
47. Production XML parse/MIME checks.
48. Production missing-resource noindex checks.
49. Post-release stale-cache distinction so crawler cache is never confused with origin truth.
50. Durable evidence, planned-vs-actual delta, remaining-work closure, and takeover-safe handoff.
